name: Hack-Nation 6th Global AI Hackathon
theme: Global AI hackathon with sponsor-specific challenges spanning voice negotiation, venture investing, affordable housing readiness, healthcare facility intelligence, women’s hormonal health open science, and defensive bacterial AMR prediction.
tracks: OpenAI: Foundation Models for Women's Hormonal Health
team_size: Small team implied; no exact team-size limit provided.
required_or_encouraged_tech: BV-BRC genome and lab-measured AMR data

facts.claim: Teams choose one sponsor challenge and build a working hackathon prototype.
Strong submissions should be demo-first, specific to the selected challenge, grounded in real or provided data, and show a memorable transformation in about one minute.

The ElevenLabs challenge requires Estimator, Caller, and Closer modules, including real phone-price gathering, at least three distinct negotiation styles, structured itemized quotes, transcript evidence, and honesty controls.
The Maschmeyer Group challenge gives judging weights: Data Architecture and Intelligence 30%, Intelligent Analysis and Trust 25%, Investment Utility and Execution 30%, UX and Design 15%.
The RealPage challenge forbids approval, denial, score, rank, or eligibility decisions and requires consent, correction, privacy, deletion, prompt-injection resistance, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.
The RealPage judging weights are Profile accuracy 25%, Rules and math 25%, Safety and privacy 20%, Accessibility 15%, End-to-end usefulness 15%.
The Databricks challenge requires a Healthcare Facility Intelligence App on Databricks Free Edition using 10,000 Indian healthcare facility records across 51 columns.
Databricks judging weights are Evidence and Trust 35%, Product Judgment 30%, Technical Execution 25%, Ambition 10%.

The women’s hormonal health OpenAI challenge requires one reusable open-science layer such as a dataset, benchmark, model, or application, with publication of datasets, benchmarks, source code, model checkpoints, documentation, and evaluation pipelines whenever possible.
The Genome Firewall challenge is strictly defensive and must not design, modify, or suggest changes to organisms.

Genome Firewall evaluation includes balanced accuracy, resistant recall, susceptible recall, F1, AUROC, PR-AUC per drug, Brier score, reliability plot, no-call rate, accuracy after no-call, and generalization by genetically related bacterial group.

inference.claim: Across tracks, trust, evidence, calibration, deterministic checks, and workflow completion are more strategically important than broad conversational UX.
inference.rationale: Multiple tracks explicitly weight evidence, trust, safety, rules/math, calibrated confidence, and decision-support artifacts; shared constraints reject generic chatbot wrappers and dashboard-only projects.

inference.claim: Sponsor tech is likely judged by materiality: it must perform core workflow work, not appear as decorative integration.
inference.rationale: The brief states sponsor technology should be materially necessary and warns against sponsor technology used only as decoration.

inference.claim: Projects that complete narrow, auditable workflows are safer than broad end-to-end platforms.
inference.rationale: Several challenges specify one metro/program, one species, one mission track, or specific required modules, and emphasize demo legibility within about 60 seconds.

sponsor_capabilities: ElevenLabs voice agents for voice interviewing, phone calls, interruption handling, disclosure, and negotiation dialogue.
Maschmeyer Group investment workflow context: sourcing, screening, diligence, decision memos, trust scoring, founder persistence, and 24-hour $100K check decision support.

RealPage affordable-housing workflow context: application readiness, synthetic document extraction, rule retrieval, deterministic calculations, renter confirmation, packet preparation, privacy, accessibility, and human decision boundaries.
Databricks Free Edition app hosting for the required live app.
Databricks Evidence Engine pattern using messy structured and free-text facility records.
Databricks trust scoring, planner persistence, Vector Search or AI Search, Genie, MLflow tracing, Mosaic AI or Agent Bricks, and Lakebase.
OpenAI foundation-model capabilities for reusable datasets, benchmarks, models, evaluation pipelines, de-identified contribution flows, multimodal integration, and voice logging.
OpenAI defensive biosecurity framing for AMR prediction with calibrated confidence, no-call behavior, evidence separation, and human oversight.
available_datasets: ElevenLabs challenge: real phone-gathered quotes and transcripts; at least one document type for the Estimator module.
Maschmeyer challenge: pitch decks, GitHub, social signals, launches, papers, patents, hackathons, accelerators, inbound applications, and outbound sourcing signals.
RealPage challenge: synthetic pay stubs or benefit letters; versioned corpus for one affordable-housing program and rule year; gold checklist for missing or expired items.

Databricks challenge: 10,000 Indian healthcare facility records across 51 columns, including description, capability, procedure, equipment, numberDoctors, capacity, yearEstablished, source URLs, and location; numberDoctors about 36.4% coverage and capacity about 25.2% coverage.

OpenAI women’s hormonal health challenge: mcPHASES on PhysioNet with Fitbit, continuous glucose monitoring, hormone measurements, menstrual-cycle data, sleep, and symptoms; NHANES reproductive health, thyroid hormones, lab data, nutrition, and demographics.
OpenAI Genome Firewall challenge: BV-BRC genome and lab-measured AMR data; AMRFinderPlus annotations; ResFinder; cAMRah.

sanitized_brief: Build for one sponsor track with a working, demo-first prototype that shows messy evidence becoming a defensible action or decision-support artifact in about 60 seconds. Constraints: use real or provided data where specified, make sponsor technology materially necessary, avoid unsupported AI claims, and include trust, evidence, deterministic checks, state changes, and workflow completion. Tracks cover voice negotiation with ElevenLabs, venture sourcing and diligence for Maschmeyer Group, affordable-housing application readiness for RealPage, Indian healthcare facility intelligence on Databricks Free Edition, OpenAI women’s hormonal-health open-science infrastructure, and OpenAI defensive bacterial AMR prediction. Key criteria include explicit weighted judging for Maschmeyer, RealPage, and Databricks; women’s health impact, technical excellence, and foundation value for hormonal health; and calibrated predictive performance, no-call behavior, and grouped generalization for Genome Firewall. Sponsor capabilities to emphasize include ElevenLabs Agents, Databricks Apps, Mosaic AI or Agent Bricks, Genie, MLflow tracing, Vector or AI Search, Lakebase, OpenAI model/evaluation infrastructure, AMRFinderPlus, ResFinder, cAMRah, PhysioNet mcPHASES, NHANES, and BV-BRC AMR data. Blacklist labels: generic chatbot wrapper, dashboard-only analytics, document summarizer, symptom checker, generic investor dashboard, generic housing eligibility navigator, keyword-only medical facility search, isolated symptom tracker, uncalibrated AMR predictor, decorative sponsor integration, fake quote evidence, renter eligibility decisioning, and organism design or modification.
